meta.title: BG3 Party Plan — Booms, Loot, Shock & Command
meta.mode_note: Everything (builds, item interactions, damage numbers) assumes non-Honour. Several novas depend on non-Honour rules (Deepened Pact Extra-Attack stacking; Savage Attacker rerolling smite/rider dice); in Honour mode they shrink substantially.
meta.stat_assumption: Every party member is assumed to get a Hag's Hair (+1) and a Mirror of Loss (+2) on their primary ability, reaching the 20 cap (17 → 18 → 20) without a feat. Hag's Hair is normally one per playthrough; this assumes a per-character source.
meta.patch: Patch 8 (2025-04-15) + hotfixes #30–#36; Patch 8 was the final major patch.

combat_gameplan.note: Run TWO kill zones. Zone 1 (frontline) = the Bard-Held priority/boss target that Durc and Batman auto-crit into oblivion (psychic/piercing — keep water OUT of it). Zone 2 (backline adds) = the cluster Toaster Wets and detonates with maximized, doubled lightning/cold plus Batman's disadvantaged cold scrolls — physically separated so Electrified Water never touches the melee. Two sequencing linchpins: (1) initiative — the R1 chain assumes Bard acts before Sorcerer before Durc, and BG3 has NO delay-turn, so on bad rolls the nova simply slips to R2; (2) Durc's R1 bonus-action conflict (Hexblade's Curse vs GWM attack) forces the true 7-swing turn to R2. In Act 3 treat the Resonance-Stone psychic-×2 as unreliable (known post-Act-2 bug) and default Durc to the self-contained Pike + Bhaalist set.

per_character.role: Arcane-Acuity control engine: locks the priority target with Hold Monster so the melee auto-crits, then escalates to mass Command.
per_character.priority_actions: Wants to act FIRST (Hellrider's Longbow initiative). R1: ranged Slashing Flourish (2 hits) on the priority target → ~+4 Arcane Acuity (raises spell save DC THAT turn) and arms the Band of the Mystic Scoundrel → bonus-action Hold Monster at the boosted DC → Paralyzed (hold concentration). R2: Flourish again (Acuity climbs) → Hold Monster/Command on the next target. R3: Acuity near +10 → Command 'Drop'/'Prone' on up to 6 via the Wizard L6 slot, or Fear/Confusion; Counterspell the enemy caster; hand out Bardic Inspiration.
per_character.avoid: Never fire the control spell BEFORE a weapon hit lands that turn (both the Band bonus-cast AND the fresh Acuity need the Flourish to resolve first). Stay ranged/unhit: Acuity decays −2 per hit taken, and losing Bard concentration (or letting the Held target die early) drops the melee's auto-crit.

per_character.role: Party Haste engine plus a Wet + maximized-Lightning AoE aimed at the SECONDARY cluster (kept off the frontline).
per_character.priority_actions: R1: action = Twinned Haste on Durc + Batman (the extra Action fuels Durc's 6–7 swings, plus +2 AC and DEX-save advantage on both); bonus = Quickened Create Water on a separate add cluster (or let Batman's Mage Hand do the Wet). Now locked concentrating on Haste. R2+: Haste persists for free → detonate: Destructive Wrath (maximize) + Markoheshkir-empowered Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning (or Cone of Cold) on the Wet cluster — Wet doubles it, Elemental Adept ignores lightning resistance, lightning-on-water Shocks them. Save the 2nd Destructive Wrath (Amulet of the Devout) for a second cluster; hold Counterspell.
per_character.avoid: Electrified-water friendly fire — never Wet the ground Durc/Batman stand on and never arc lightning into the melee's water (recurring lightning + prone; a Wet ally takes DOUBLE enemy lightning/cold). Keep the water/lightning cluster physically separate, and guard Haste concentration (War Caster) — if it breaks, Durc and Batman go Lethargic and lose their next turn.

per_character.role: Melee crit-smite nova — the single-target finisher that deletes the Bard-Held priority target.
per_character.priority_actions: Pre-fight: bind Shadow Blade/Pike and short-rest to refund the pact slot; position so Aura of Protection (+CHA saves) and Aura of Hate (+CHA melee damage) blanket the melee cluster and the Resonance-Stone carrier. R1: bonus = Hexblade's Curse on the Paralyzed target; action (3) + Haste action (3) = 6 auto-crit strikes, Divine Smite the biggest slots first (doubled on the crit; psychic doubled again by the stone), Half-Orc extra die, Savage Attacker rerolls → ~800–1000 on a Held target. R2+ (Curse up, bonus free): full 7 swings incl. the GWM bonus-attack-on-crit; use Killer's Sweetheart's guaranteed crit after a kill; when smites dry up, plain Hasted swings.
per_character.avoid: Do not stand in the Sorcerer's water (electrify + Wet doubles enemy lightning/cold on you). On R1 do NOT spend the bonus action on the GWM attack instead of Hexblade's Curse — Curse can't be pre-cast before initiative, and its +damage rider is what the doubled-nova math depends on (the GWM swing only comes online R2 once Curse is already up).

per_character.role: Stealth assassin / DEX-save nuker: one massive ambush strike on the Held target, plus ownership of the Wet-and-cold AoE lane and the free water-bottle setup.
per_character.priority_actions: Pre-fight: pre-cast 3d8 Shadow Blade (Superior Elixir, no concentration); place the Resonance Stone by the melee cluster inside Durc's Aura; start Hidden; invisible Mage Hand throws water bottles to pre-Wet the enemy cluster. Each turn: bonus = Hide (Reliable Talent → near-automatic; arms Magical Ambush AND Sneak-Attack advantage), action = Booming Blade + Shadow Blade + Sneak Attack 6d6 as ONE strike — auto-crit on the Held target, whole strike doubled psychic by the stone. On a kill, Deathstalker Mantle turns him Invisible → reposition + re-ambush. When Durc already covers the melee target, crouch-cast a stolen cold scroll (Ice Storm / Cone of Cold) into the Wet cluster at disadvantage (Magical Ambush).
per_character.avoid: Don't linger in melee after the alpha strike — he's squishy (lean on Cunning Action Disengage/Hide, Misty Step, Uncanny Dodge + Evasion + Shield). He sits INSIDE his own Resonance Stone aura with no Gnome Cunning: vs psychic/mind enemies the stone gives HIM psychic vulnerability + disadvantage on mental saves, so keep him in Durc's Aura of Protection — or don't deploy the stone that fight.

opening_rotation.action: Long-rest buffs: Durc and Batman each pre-cast 3d8 Shadow Blade via a Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation (no concentration); Durc binds his Pact weapon and short-rests to refund the slot. Batman goes Hidden and places the Resonance Stone where the melee will cluster (inside Durc's planned Aura, away from psychic-save-fragile allies); his invisible Mage Hand throws water bottles to pre-Wet the add cluster. Open from stealth for a surprise round.

Ranged Slashing Flourish (2 hits) on the boss → ~+4 Arcane Acuity (raises spell save DC this turn) and arms the Band of the Mystic Scoundrel → bonus-action Hold Monster → boss fails its WIS save → Paralyzed. Hold concentration on the lock.

Action = Twinned Haste on Durc + Batman (extra Action + +2 AC / DEX-save advantage). Bonus = Quickened Create Water on a SEPARATE add cluster, not under the melee. Sorcerer now locked concentrating on Haste; boss Held, adds Wet for next round.

Bonus = Hexblade's Curse on the Paralyzed boss. Action (3) + Haste action (3) = 6 auto-crit Shadow Blade strikes; Divine Smite the top slots first (doubled on the crit, psychic doubled again by the stone), Half-Orc die, Savage Attacker rerolls. Boss deleted or near-dead (~800–1000). No GWM bonus attack this round — the bonus was spent on Curse.

Bonus = Hide (near-automatic). Action = Booming Blade + Shadow Blade + Sneak Attack 6d6 as one strike on the boss (auto-crit while Held, doubled psychic by the stone) → finishes it. The kill triggers the Deathstalker Mantle → Batman turns Invisible.

If you surprised them, they skip this round. Otherwise they act with the alpha target already dead/locked: Batman is Invisible, Durc soaks behind +2 AC from Haste, everyone in the aura has +CHA to saves.
Slashing Flourish on the next priority target (Acuity now ~+6 to +8, control near-unresistable) → bonus-action Hold Monster on it; drop concentration on the dead boss. New target Paralyzed.

Haste persists for free → action open to nuke: Destructive Wrath (maximize) + Markoheshkir Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning (or Cone of Cold) on the Wet add cluster — doubled by Wet, Elemental Adept ignores lightning resist, lightning-on-water Shocks them. Keep the blast clear of the melee.

Move to the new Held target. Full 7 swings now — Curse already up, so the bonus is free for the GWM bonus-attack-on-crit. Smite with remaining slots; once dry, plain Hasted swings. Killer's Sweetheart guarantees a crit on the first hit after a kill.

Still Invisible from the R1 kill → open with the big Booming-Blade/Shadow-Blade/Sneak strike on the new Held target (auto-crit), OR crouch-cast a stolen Ice Storm/Cone of Cold into the Wet cluster at disadvantage (Magical Ambush). Mage Hand re-Wets a fresh target or flanks to guarantee Sneak Attack. Then Hide/Disengage out.
Acuity at/near +10 → Command ('Drop'/'Prone') on up to 6 enemies via the Wizard L6 slot, or Fear/Confusion to mass-lock the rest. Counterspell the enemy caster; hand out Bardic Inspiration.
Second Destructive Wrath (Amulet of the Devout) on the next Wet cluster, or Counterspell / Quickened Lightning Bolt on stragglers. Haste stays concentrated on the melee pair.

Clean up the controlled/prone enemies (advantage everywhere, guaranteed crits on any still Held). Durc falls back to plain swings / Lay on Hands once out of smites; Batman hit-and-runs — kill a low target to re-proc Deathstalker invisibility, reposition, ambush again. Short-rest after the fight to refuel Durc's spell + pact slots.

watch_outs.detail: Paladin/Warlock/Sorc/Bard are all CHA; lean on the Trickster (Expertise + Perception/Investigation) for the DEX/INT/WIS skills.

Its aura makes the whole party (incl. its Astarion carrier — no Gnome Cunning) psychic-vulnerable + disadvantage on mental saves; cluster it near the Paladin's Aura of Protection and keep it off save-fragile allies vs psychic/mind enemies.
The 3-attack stack works only outside Honour mode; don't drop Warlock below 5.

watch_outs.watch_out: Undead / crit-immune bosses break the nova (no respec needed)
watch_outs.detail: Hold Monster & Command have NO effect on undead, the Resonance Stone excludes undead + constructs, and crit-immunity gear cancels auto-crits — so BOTH melee multipliers die vs Ketheric (Act 2), Cazador, the Steel Watchers, and the Netherbrain. Fallback (all tactical, no respec): (1) SimonSays swaps to Hypnotic Pattern / Slow (work on undead) instead of Hold Monster, and keeps Healing Word for emergencies; (2) Durc drops the Resonance Stone and leans on Risky-Ring advantage + Spiteful Suffering for crit-fishing — his Divine Smite already deals +1d8 vs Undead/Fiends, so radiant smites are actually STRONG here; (3) Toaster/Batman are unaffected (lightning/force work on undead). Treat the Hold→auto-crit→Stone nova as an anti-LIVING-boss package.

proficiencies.note: Who actually covers each skill (★ Expertise = doubled bonus · ● Proficient · ½ Jack of All Trades = half proficiency on non-proficient checks). Save/background/racial proficiencies are fixed; class skill picks are the plan's recommended loadout. The party is CHA-heavy, so Batman carries the DEX/INT/WIS skills while three characters can face.

legend.jack: ½ Jack of All Trades (half proficiency on non-proficient ability checks)

Durc.source: Half-Orc (Intimidation) + Haunted One background (Intimidation, Medicine) + Warlock's 2 picks (Deception, Religion). No Expertise, but CHA 20 makes Intimidation/Deception a genuine secondary face.

Batman.source: Charlatan background (Deception, Sleight of Hand) + High Elf (Perception) + Rogue's 4 picks (Stealth, Investigation, Acrobatics, Insight). Expertise: SoH + Stealth (Rogue 1), Perception + Investigation (Rogue 6). Reliable Talent floors all proficient checks at 10 from level 12 — the party's skill monkey.

Toaster.source: Sage background (Arcana, History) + Sorcerer's 2 picks (Persuasion, Insight) + Human free skill (Perception). CHA 20 → a decent Persuasion backup.

SimonSays.source: Guild Artisan background (Insight, Persuasion) + Human free skill (Deception) + Fighter's 2 picks (Perception, Athletics) + Bard's picks (Performance, Intimidation). Expertise ×4 (Bard 3 + Bard 10). Jack of All Trades adds half proficiency to every OTHER check — the primary face + skill generalist.

Not a prepared spell and not stopped by Counterspell — set the Critical-Hit Divine Smite reactions to auto-confirm.

The one prepared spell in the nova line: +1d6 psychic (doubles to 2d6 on a crit) and can Frighten. Concentration — cast once and it rides subsequent swings.

Reaction +5 AC to dodge an incoming hit; not concentration; strong survival pick for a melee body.
Temp HP + Cold retaliation that scales with the pact slot — 15 temp HP / 15 Cold from a Warlock-5 L3 pact slot. Not concentration.
+1d4 to attack rolls and saves for up to 3 allies; best pre-fight buff on turns not riding Wrathful Smite.
Cheap single-target control (Drop / Halt / Approach) to open a nova or peel an enemy caster.
Free ALWAYS-PREPARED Oathbreaker oath spell; reaction fire damage when hit, at zero prepared-slot cost.
Free always-prepared oath spell; vision denial Durc can fight inside via the Warlock's Devil's Sight.
1d4+CHA Necrotic/turn AND grants all attackers Advantage on the target — a self-contained advantage/crit-fishing source when the Risky Ring isn't equipped.
Ranged fallback for turns he can't reach melee (2 beams at char 5, 3 at char 10); a real option with Agonising Blast + CHA 20.

Durc.playstyle: Pre-apply Hexblade's Curse the turn before so the bonus action is free. Nova turn: attack (3) + Haste (3) + GWM bonus attack (1) = 7 auto-crit swings on a Held target, smiting each; short rest to refuel. Half-Orc adds a die on crits; Curse drops the crit threshold to 19–20; Risky Ring keeps you at advantage. Dark Urge bonus: A Most Bloody Inheritance (from the Act-3 Murder questline) reduces Durc's crit threshold by a further −2, stacking with Curse (−1) + Sarevok's Helmet + Covert Cowl — a very wide crit range for non-Held targets.

late_game_config.note: At Act 3 you can run either weapon set.
late_game_config.shadow_blade_set: 3d8 psychic one-hander + shield; ×2 from the Trickster's Resonance Stone (shared, buggy); GWM bonus attack only.
late_game_config.piercing_set: Heavy piercing Pike (1d10) two-handed; ×2 from your own Bhaalist Armour (always on); GWM bonus attack + All In (-5/+10); no shield.

nova.assumptions: Held target (every hit auto-crits), full 8-slot dump. Smites double their dice on a crit; Half-Orc adds a die; Savage Attacker rerolls every die (d8→5.81, d10→7.15, d6→4.47). Flat weapon bonuses (CHA 5 + Aura of Hate 5 + Improved Pact Weapon 1 + Curse 4 [+ GWM 10 on the pike]) ride the weapon's type so they double; smites are radiant so neither aura doubles them.
nova.caveats: Shadow Blade + Resonance Stone has the higher ceiling (~1,070) but rides the Trickster's shared, buggy stone — without it it falls to ~670, so the Pike is better whenever the stone isn't up. Both figures assume the Savage-Attacker-rerolls-smite quirk (bg3.wiki: 'unknown if bugged/intended') and that Hexblade's Curse's +4 rides the weapon's type; if Curse is untyped, shave ~28 off each.

Batman.name: The Ambusher — Melee Shadow-Blade (Config A)

pickpocket.note: Batman is the party's thief — this is how he lifts key gear, scrolls, and buff sources with near-certainty, and gets away clean on the rare miss. ⚠ CORRECTION: pickpocketing resolves as a BACKGROUND d20 roll, so variable dice like Guidance and Bardic Inspiration do NOT apply to it — only FLAT Sleight-of-Hand bonuses (gear) change the number. The guaranteed ceiling is therefore fixed by Reliable Talent + flat gear, not buffs. Applies to both configs (the War Cleric dip's Guidance is for dialogue/other checks, not the steal).
pickpocket.check_formula: Pickpocketing rolls Sleight of Hand: d20 + DEX mod + proficiency, with Expertise DOUBLING proficiency. At char 12 with DEX 20 (+5) and Expertise (+8) that's a +13 flat. Reliable Talent (Rogue 11) floors the raw d20 at 10 on proficient skills, so his minimum result is 10 + 13 = 23 and a natural 1 can't auto-fail. Proficiency does NOT stack from multiple sources; only Expertise raises it.
pickpocket.success_math: The number the UI shows is a 'roll target' = the raw d20 you need (flat bonuses already subtracted), NOT the DC. Reliable Talent floors the die at 10, so ANY item with roll target ≤ 10 (underlying DC ≤ 23) is a GUARANTEED steal with zero setup. To beat a HIGHER target you must add FLAT Sleight-of-Hand gear (Smuggler's Ring +2 → target ≤ 12; + Gloves of Power +1 → ≤ 13) — Guidance and Bardic Inspiration do NOT apply to the background pickpocket roll. Advantage (Graceful Cloth) doesn't raise the guaranteed floor but makes mid/high targets very likely. Virtually every merchant item sits at DC ≤ 23, so Batman auto-succeeds on nearly all of them; for the rare over-floor item use flat gear, or Enthrall the vendor and steal freely.
pickpocket.detection: Pickpocketing requires being HIDDEN; opening/closing the steal window is free while unseen (only clicking Steal rolls). A failed steal and 'caught possessing stolen goods' are SEPARATE crimes. On a fail the victim attacks or offers a Deception/Intimidation/Persuasion check (pass = they watch you; a 2nd catch = arrest). Even a SUCCESS starts a delayed investigation: the victim searches for a few turns — if you stay out of sight/range until it expires, the whole party is permanently safe (you can then wear the stolen item openly). An accused character carrying no session-stolen loot always proves innocence.

pickpocket.procedure:
0 — Standing kit: wear the Graceful Cloth (permanent Cat's Grace = advantage on DEX checks + DEX toward 20) all game; Gloves of Thievery as backup. Confirm DEX 20. This alone gives +13 flat, advantage, and (Rogue 11) a floor-10 die = guaranteed steal on any DC ≤ 23 item.
1 — Isolate: split Batman from the party and approach the target alone, so a botched job only implicates him and no ally is caught holding loot.
2 — Confirm flat gear: the Graceful Cloth already gives advantage. For a high-target item, swap in a Smuggler's Ring (+2) / Gloves of Power (+1) — these LOWER the shown target. (Guidance/Bardic Inspiration do NOT help the steal roll.)
3 — Quicksave.
4 — Turn-based ON: freeze patrols, the victim, and the investigation timer.
5 — Hide: bonus-action Hide (Cunning Action; near-automatic). If a vision cone is a problem, use Fog Cloud/Darkness (auto-hide).
6 — Read targets: open the steal window (free while unseen). Roll target ≤ 10 = auto-lift; advantage from the Cloth makes higher targets very likely. Prioritize high value / low target (key gear, scrolls, buff sources). For a rare over-floor item, swap in a flat +SoH ring (Smuggler's/Gloves of Power) or just Enthrall the vendor and steal freely — Guidance/Bardic Inspiration won't help the roll.
7 — Steal item by item: one per pickpocket. To pull more from the same NPC, re-hide or hand off to a second hidden member. Reload if a roll would fail.
8 — Escape BEFORE the alert matures: break line of sight and leave the search radius — Cunning Action Disengage/Dash or a bonus-action Misty Step. Do NOT rely on the Deathstalker Mantle. Stay out of sight until the 'Thief!' investigation expires.
9 — Launder the loot: keep stolen goods off Batman if guards may sweep. If caught anyway: pass the confront check, return/drop the item, or have an ally Enthrall / Feign Death — or reload.
10 — Turn-based OFF and resume.

spells.note: Sorcerer is a KNOWN caster (learn on level-up, replace 1 per level); the Tempest Cleric 2 dip is a prepared caster re-picked freely. Mandatory = the wet-lightning engine + Haste; Recommended = flex nukes and utility.

mandatory.why: 1d12 Lightning, Concentration; re-activate each turn with no roll, builds Lightning Charges on The Spellsparkler, and works with Destructive Wrath.
2d8 Lightning that creates an Electrified Water surface; upcasts +1d8/level; triggers Destructive Wrath — cheap single-target lightning that sets up the electrify combo.
8d6 Lightning line — the main AoE nuke; doubled vs Wet, maximized by Destructive Wrath, boosted by Elemental Affinity + Elemental Adept.
Single-target so Twinnable; Twinned Haste (3 sorcery points) on the Paladin is the party Haste engine. Never cast another Concentration spell after it.
Shuts down enemy casters; upcast to beat higher-level spells without a check.
NOT a Sorcerer spell — obtained via the Tempest dip (prepared). Applies Wet (double Lightning/Cold), which doubles the whole lightning package. No save, so low WIS is irrelevant.
The payoff: spend a Channel Divinity charge to MAXIMISE any Thunder/Lightning roll (Lightning Bolt / Chain Lightning / Markoheshkir bolts / Thunderwave). 1/rest (2 with Amulet of the Devout).

recommended.why: Best lightning cantrip: 1d8→3d8 by char 10, strips Reactions, advantage vs metal armour; scales with Potent Robe, Elemental Affinity, Spellmight Gloves, Markoheshkir; the War Caster opportunity-spell payload.
5d8 Cold AoE; off-element for Elemental Adept: Lightning, but Wet gives Cold vulnerability too so it still doubles.
8d6 Fire AoE flex for fire-vulnerable or non-Wet packs; off-type (no Elemental Affinity/Adept synergy), situational.
Reposition out of your own electrified water.
Free domain spell: 2d8 Thunder + knockback; a Thunder roll, so Destructive Wrath maximises it (16 guaranteed) and it triggers Reverberation gear.
Party max-HP buff, no concentration, no save — a strong prepared pick that ignores the low WIS DC.

recommended.when: Markoheshkir / scroll only (Sorc learns it at class 11, unreached)
recommended.why: 10d8 Lightning — accessed via Markoheshkir (Kereska's Favour / Bolts of Doom, 1/short rest) or scrolls, not learned at Sorc 10.
CORRECTION: listed in the party plan but NOT a Sorcerer spell (Bard/Cleric/Wizard, class level 5); the Cleric dip only reaches level 2, so this build can only cast it from scrolls.

respecs.label: Level 1
respecs.note: Gale is recruited on the Ravaged Beach as a level-1 Evocation Wizard. Do NOT level him as a Wizard — respec him into the Sorcerer build at Withers as soon as you can afford it (~100g). See the Respec tab for the actual leveling.

rows.gains: Recruited state only — Evocation Wizard. A placeholder until the Withers respec into Sorcerer.

respecs.label: Respec → Sorcerer
respecs.note: Respec at Withers (~100g) and rebuild from level 1 as a Draconic (Blue) Sorcerer. Assign the starting stats during the respec (the CHA 17 uses Human's +2 racial) and re-pick Metamagic/spells to match this plan. Final: Sorcerer 10 → Tempest Cleric 2.

rows.gains: Draconic Bloodline (Blue → Lightning); Witch Bolt free from Blue ancestry; 4 cantrips (Shocking Grasp) + 2 spells; +1 HP/level (Draconic Resilience)
Font of Magic (sorcery points); Metamagic: Twinned + Quickened Spell (Extended later)
L2 spells (Misty Step); more sorcery points
Feat: War Caster
3rd-level slots → Haste (Twinned Haste on the Paladin), Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, Fireball
Draconic 6: Elemental Affinity — add CHA to Lightning damage
4th-level slots
Feat: Elemental Adept (Lightning — ignore Lightning resistance; treat 1s on damage dice as 2s)
5th-level slots (Cone of Cold)
Sorcerer capstone for this build; 6 cantrips; final Metamagic pick
Create/Destroy Water (the Wet engine → doubles Lightning/Cold); heavy armour + shields; Thunderwave domain spell
Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath — maximise any Lightning/Thunder roll

act1: The Spellsparkler
Head slot open (the Diadem of Arcane Synergy went to Durc — its weapon-damage buff is dead on a pure caster); save it for a spell-DC hat (Hood of the Weave / Birthright later)
act2: Potent Robe (Alfira at Last Light — only if she survived Act 1)
act3: Markoheshkir (Kereska's Favour → Lightning)

Gloves of Belligerent Skies (Crèche, Act 1) — every Lightning/Thunder hit stacks Reverberation → 5 stacks = CON save or Prone; turns each AoE into soft-CC. (Spellmight Gloves do NOTHING for this kit — they need spell ATTACK rolls, and everything here is save-based.)
Birthright (+2 CHA)
Amulet of the Devout (extra Destructive Wrath) — Toaster keeps the neck; the Amulet of Greater Health went to the Bard

Toaster.playstyle: Soak enemies with Create Water (Wet = lightning/cold vulnerability), then maximize with Destructive Wrath. Doubles as the party's Haste engine via Twinned Haste on the Paladin.
traps: Friendly fire: electrified water damages anyone standing in it (incl. your melee), and Wet makes your own frontliner take double enemy lightning/cold — soak clusters that don't overlap the Paladin.

Gale's Netherese orb: a one-off early-Act-1 chore — feed him 3 magic items (The Wizard of Waterdeep) and it resolves; ignoring it stacks Arcane Hunger debuffs and only the final stage is fatal. Not an ongoing tax.
Respec cost: Gale joins as a Wizard — bank ~100g for the Withers respec into Sorcerer, and re-pick metamagic/spells to match this plan.

SimonSays.name: The Commander
SimonSays.role: Ranged acuity control + damage + party face
SimonSays.build_order: Pure Swords Bard to 7 → respec at 8 → Fighter 1 → Wizard 1 → Swords Bard 1–10.
SimonSays.stats_note: Adopt Gloves of Dexterity (DEX 18) then respec DEX points into INT 16.
SimonSays.ability_targets: CHA 17 → 18 (Hag's Hair) → 20 (Mirror of Loss); 22 via a later ASI if using a shield.

feats.note: Swapped from Dual Wielder (useless on a two-handed longbow). Advantage on CON saves to hold Hold Monster — the party's melee auto-crit engine — plus opportunity-spell casting. (Triggers at Bard class level 8.)

creation.level1_class: Fighter 1 (first class in the final post-respec build)
creation.level1_gains: Archery fighting style (+2 ranged), Second Wind, and — because Fighter is taken FIRST — STR + CON save proficiency, all armour (incl. Heavy) + Shields + Martial weapons, and 2 Fighter skills.
creation.subclass_choice: College of Swords is chosen at Bard 3 (Blade Flourish, a fighting style, Medium armour + Scimitars); Extra Attack at Bard 6. The Fighter/Wizard dips have no subclass at these levels.

proficiencies.armor_weapons: From Fighter 1 (first class): Light/Medium/Heavy armour, Shields, Simple + Martial weapons + the Archery fighting style. College of Swords also adds Medium armour + Scimitars.
proficiencies.saving_throws: Strength + Constitution — from Fighter as the FIRST class (CON = concentration insurance for Hold Monster / Fear / Confusion). Multiclassing into Bard/Wizard grants no additional save proficiency.
proficiencies.skills: Fighter picks 2 (Perception + Athletics, or Insight for the face). Bard adds 3 skills + Expertise on 2 (Bard 3) and 2 more (Bard 10) + Jack of All Trades (Bard 2) — the face/skill engine. Background Entertainer/Guild Artisan adds 2.

creation.starting_cantrips: Bard: 2 at Bard 1 (Vicious Mockery, Friends) → 4 by Bard 10. The Wizard dip adds 3 INT cantrips (filler).
creation.starting_spells: Bard: 4 known at Bard 1 → 13 by Bard 10 + 2 Magical Secrets. Wizard 1: 6 spellbook picks — MUST include Shield (there is no Shield scroll to transcribe).
creation.notes: Half-Elf/Human. Final order (after the level-8 respec): Fighter 1 → Wizard 1 → Swords Bard ×10 = caster level 11 → a single L6 slot (the Wizard dip's whole point: Command up to 6 targets). Pre-respec you play pure Swords Bard 1–7. Feats/ASIs at Bard class levels 4 and 8.

spells.note: Bard is a known caster (Always Prepared, replace 1 per level-up); Wizard-dip spells key off INT and re-prepare freely. Mandatory = the acuity-control engine; Recommended = the wider control/utility toolbox.

mandatory.why: +2 ranged attack for the Slashing-Flourish → Arcane-Acuity engine (Hellrider's Longbow → Gontr Mael).
Paralyse — attacks within 3m auto-crit, the party's melee auto-crit engine for Durc's smites. Upcast adds +1 target per slot above 5th. Concentration.
The bonus-action loop via the Band of the Mystic Scoundrel; +1 target per slot above 1st, so the Wizard-dip L6 slot hits up to 6. DC uses CHA + Arcane Acuity.
Pre-placed AoE burst (5d8, choose element) set before a fight as a ground trap.
+5 AC reaction and negates Magic Missile — the survivability payoff of the Wizard dip. Must be one of the 6 Wizard-1 picks (no Shield scroll exists).

recommended.why: 9m cone — frightened enemies drop weapons and can't act/approach; scales with CHA + Arcane Acuity. Concentration.
6m scramble — enemies attack randomly / skip turns. Concentration.
Best-in-class AoE lockdown (9m incapacitate); superb acuity payoff. Concentration; breaks on damage.
Shuts off enemy casters as a Reaction.
Cheaper single-target paralyse (auto-crit within 3m), available far earlier than Hold Monster — the early-game stand-in. Concentration.
Turn a humanoid against its allies; a flex 5th-level pick alongside Hold Monster. Concentration.
Reliable chip damage and a dependable concentration-breaker; force is INT-independent so it stays useful at INT 16.
Psychic damage + disadvantage on the target's next attack; free ranged control that plays into acuity.
Advantage on Charisma checks vs a non-hostile creature — the face enabler. Never cast on companions (approval loss when it ends).

UNDEAD-PROOF control (unlike Hold Monster/Command) — halves speed, −2 AC/DEX-saves, one action only, ~50% chance to fizzle a cast. Bank it as a known spell for the Act-2/undead/construct fights where paralyze doesn't work. Concentration.
The no-healer party's emergency pickup: bonus-action ranged revive/heal so a downed ally doesn't cost a full turn. Cheap insurance to keep known — pairs with stocked Revivify scrolls.

respecs.label: Level 1
respecs.note: How you build from character creation and play until the level-8 respec — pure Swords Bard, no multiclassing yet.

rows.gains: Bardic Inspiration; 2 cantrips + 4 spells known (Vicious Mockery, Friends, Healing Word); Bard skills + Expertise setup
Jack of All Trades (½ prof to non-proficient checks); Song of Rest
College of Swords: Blade Flourish + Dueling fighting style, Medium armour + Scimitars; Expertise ×2; L2 spells (Hold Person)
Feat: Sharpshooter
L3 spells (Glyph of Warding, Fear, Hypnotic Pattern, Slow); Font of Inspiration (Bardic Inspiration on short rest)
Extra Attack → two ranged Slashing Flourishes in one action (+8 Arcane Acuity on turn 1)
L4 spells (Confusion); last level before the respec

respecs.label: Level 8 respec
respecs.note: At char level 8, respec at Withers and rebuild from level 1 in this exact order. You're char level 8 the moment the rebuild reaches Bard 6 (Extra Attack); levels 9–12 then continue as Bard 7–10. Final: Fighter 1 → Wizard 1 → Swords Bard ×10.

rows.gains: Taken FIRST: Archery fighting style (+2 ranged), Second Wind; STR + CON save proficiency; all armour (incl. Heavy) + Shields + Martial weapons; 2 Fighter skills
Spellbook (6 picks — MUST include Shield; add Magic Missile); Arcane Recovery; scribe scrolls; 3 INT cantrips
Bardic Inspiration; Bard cantrips + spells (Vicious Mockery, Friends, Healing Word)
Jack of All Trades; Song of Rest
College of Swords: Blade Flourish + Dueling style, Medium armour + Scimitars; Expertise ×2; L2 spells (Hold Person)
Feat: Sharpshooter (retaken)
L3 spells (Glyph of Warding, Fear, Hypnotic Pattern, Slow); Font of Inspiration
Extra Attack — the rebuild catches up to your char level here; two ranged Slashing Flourishes/turn
L4 spells (Confusion)
Feat: War Caster (advantage on CON saves to hold Hold Monster; opportunity-spell casting)
L5 spells (Hold Monster — the melee auto-crit engine; Dominate Person)
Magical Secrets (Command + Counterspell); 2 more Expertise; caster level 11 → the single L6 slot (Command up to 6 targets)

act1: Hellrider's Longbow (Rivington — initiative)
Gloves of Dexterity (DEX 18)
act2: Helmet of Arcane Acuity (Mason's Guild — +2 acuity/hit → +spell save DC)
act3: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel (Akabi's Circus wheel → Chult jungle — cast Enchantment/Illusion as a bonus action after a weapon hit)
Gontr Mael (top bow — but it grants NO initiative; keep Hellrider's Longbow if you need to act first)
Amulet of Greater Health (CON 23) — reallocated here to armour Hold Monster concentration; stacks with War Caster

SimonSays.playstyle: OPENING: with Extra Attack (Bard 6), Blade Flourish is NOT once-per-turn — fire TWO ranged Slashing Flourishes in one Attack action = 4 hits = +8 Arcane Acuity on turn 1 (not +4), then convert via the Band of the Mystic Scoundrel into a bonus-action Hold Monster at the boosted DC. Sustain: land a flourish EVERY turn (Acuity also decays −1/turn on top of −2 per hit taken) to hold the DC; cap 10 = +10 spell save DC. The Wizard-dip 6th-level slot lets Command hit up to 6. ⚠ Hold Monster & Command have NO effect on undead — see the party undead-fallback plan; carry Hypnotic Pattern/Slow for those fights.

items.name: Everburn Blade
items.note: Looted from Commander Zhalk at the helm (kill him during the escape, or Command: Drop). Greatsword 2d6 + 1d4 fire, magical — Durc's early crit-smite weapon.

events.name: Recruit Lae'zel
events.note: Freed from her pod on the ship.

events.name: Tadpole / Illithid Powers unlock
events.note: You're infected here; the Dream Guardian later unlocks the Illithid Powers tree.

items.name: Deathstalker Mantle
items.note: DARK URGE EXCLUSIVE — given by Sceleritas Fel at camp in Act 1. Once/turn, killing a creature turns you Invisible for 2 turns. Durc (the Dark Urge) receives it, then hands it to Batman (the assassin's reposition/re-ambush cloak).

events.name: Withers — recruit + RESPEC
events.note: Sarcophagus in the Dank Crypt (Overgrown Ruins). Enables respec (100g) / revive / hirelings at camp — needed for every respec in this plan.

events.name: Recruit Shadowheart, Astarion, Gale
events.note: Beach/cliffs area.

items.name: Ring of Protection
items.note: From Mol in the Tiefling Hideout (pickpocket or gifted). +1 AC and +1 to all saves — top universal defensive ring.

items.name: Whispering Promise + Hellrider's Pride
items.note: Whispering Promise (Volo) + Hellrider's Pride (Zevlor/Kagha): a Bless-on-heal + resistance-on-heal combo for a support healer.

items.name: Gloves of Power
items.note: Carried by Za'krug at the Grove gate (or looted from the goblin who wears it). +1 Sleight of Hand, and while the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand its weapon hits inflict Absolute's Bane (−1d4 to the target's attacks & saves). NOT a +attack/DC item — a cheap flat pickpocket helper.

items.name: Sorrow (glaive)
items.note: Emerald Grove Hidden Vault (Wolf altar; unlocked via the Enclave Library puzzle). +1 reach glaive that grants the Sorrowful Lash cantrip — a decent early polearm for a martial/GWM user.

events.name: Save the Grove
events.note: Central Act 1 hub — good path (kill goblin leaders) vs evil (raid with Minthara).

events.name: Recruit Wyll
events.note: Training tieflings at the grove.

items.name: Auntie Ethel's Hair (Hag's Hair)
items.note: Consumable: permanent +1 to ANY ability, uncapped. The plan assumes each PC gets one — it's the +1 that carries everyone's primary from 17→18 (then Mirror of Loss → 20).

events.name: Get the Hag's Hair
events.note: Drop Ethel low, then trigger her deal-offer cutscene and KILL her to loot the Hair. Do NOT accept a bargain (it breaks Durc's Paladin oath, and gives less).

events.name: Rescue Mayrina
events.note: Bitter Divorce questline.

items.name: Bracers of Defence
items.note: Apothecary's secret cellar beneath the village. +2 AC while wearing no armour and no shield — Batman's AC without armour.

items.name: Sussur weapons (Dagger/Greatsword)
items.note: Craft at the Blacksmith with Sussur Tree Bark (from the Sussur Tree in the Whispering Depths). On-hit Silence — shuts down enemy casters.

events.name: The Necromancy of Thay
events.note: Permanent Speak with Dead (risky WIS saves) — behind a locked gate, opened with the Dark Amethyst.

events.name: Whispering Depths / Sussur Tree
events.note: Silence-bark for the weapons + Dark Amethyst; Phase Spider Matriarch; a pit drops to the Underdark.

items.name: Amulet of Misty Step
items.note: Gilded chest in Priestess Gut's chambers (Defiled Temple). Bonus-action Misty Step with no slot — free repositioning.

items.name: Goblin-leader loot (Gut / Ragzlin / Minthara)
items.note: The three goblin bosses drop assorted +1 weapons, potions, and gold — sweep the Shattered Sanctum before it turns hostile.

events.name: Volo's Ersatz Eye — permanent See Invisibility
events.note: Rescue Volo (caged), let him operate at camp → Ersatz Eye (9m See Invisibility). Must be received via dialogue.

events.name: Recruit Halsin / Minthara
events.note: Free Halsin (good) or side with goblins for Minthara (evil, raids the Grove).

items.name: The Spellsparkler
items.note: Reward from Counsellor Florrick for rescuing her at the burning Waukeen's Rest. Quarterstaff — casting builds Lightning Charges. Toaster's early staff.

items.name: Gloves of Thievery
items.note: Sold by Brem in the Zhentarim Basement (after 'Find the Missing Shipment'). Advantage on Sleight of Hand — core thief glove.

items.name: Titanstring Bow
items.note: Brem (Zhentarim). Adds STR mod to ranged damage — best Act 1 bow (great with a STR-set item like the Club of Hill Giant Strength or Hill Giant elixirs).

items.name: Zhentarim vendor stock (Brem / Sparkle)
items.note: The basement traders sell +1 hand crossbows, Smokepowder Bombs/Barrels (chasm & burst strats), scrolls, and misc gear — a one-stop Act 1 shop. Steal-friendly.

events.name: Rescue the Grand Duke (Waukeen's Rest fire)
events.note: Save Florrick → The Spellsparkler + Flaming Fist plotline.

events.name: Recruit Karlach
events.note: On the Risen Road; Anders' paladins want her dead — help her vs kill for the reward.

items.name: Boots of Stormy Clamour
items.note: Sold by Omeluum (Ebonlake Grotto) after 'Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite'. Applies 2 turns of Reverberation when you inflict a condition — a Reverberation staple, acquired in Act 1.

items.name: Phalar Aluve
items.note: Longsword in stone near the Selunite Outpost. Sing (buff allies) / Shriek (thunder AoE + debuff) — great for almost anyone.

items.name: Caustic Band + Club of Hill Giant Strength
items.note: Caustic Band (Derryth): +2 acid on weapon hits. Club (Arcane Tower): sets STR to 19 — off-hand it to free a non-STR build.

items.name: Ring of Mind-Shielding
items.note: Omeluum's reward for 'Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite' (Ebonlake Grotto — persuade, pay, or steal). Advantage on saves vs Charmed + can't be possessed/read — solid utility ring.

events.name: Help Omeluum
events.note: Myconid Colony — reward includes the Amulet of Misty Step or a ring, opens Omeluum's shop (Boots of Stormy Clamour).

events.name: Arcane Tower
events.note: Reactivate the tower; loot the Club of Hill Giant Strength + scrolls.

items.name: Disintegrating Night Walkers
items.note: Loot from True Soul Nere. Bonus-action Misty Step (1/short rest) + immunity to Web/Entangle/grease-slip — assassin mobility.

items.name: Adamantine armour + shield (crafted)
items.note: Adamantine Forge with Mithral Ore: Splint (AC 18), Scale Mail (medium), Shield, Longsword, or Mace — all give −damage, crit immunity, and reel attackers. Best Act 1 gear; Mithral is limited (~2 moulds), so plan which pieces to craft.

items.name: Sentient Amulet
items.note: Grymforge, locked Adamantine chest near the Lava Elemental. A chatty amulet that casts Shatter (1/short rest; WIS save or the wielder becomes Hysterical) + Ki Restoration — Monk-flavoured, niche for this party.

events.name: Adamantine Forge
events.note: Pour Mithral + mould, then fight Grym (lure onto the forge). One-time crafting.

events.name: True Soul Nere
events.note: Free the deep gnomes vs side with the duergar; loot Nere for the Night Walkers.

areas.area: Mountain Pass / Rosymorn Monastery / Crèche Y'llek

items.name: Graceful Cloth
items.note: Sold by Lady Esther (Rosymorn trail). +2 DEX (cap 20) + Cat's Grace (advantage on DEX checks — helps stealing). Batman's all-game chest.

items.name: Knife of the Undermountain King
items.note: Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera (Crèche). +2 finesse shortsword, crit on 19–20, advantage vs obscured — Batman's main-hand until Shadow Blade.

items.name: Gloves of Dexterity
items.note: A'jak'nir Jeera (Crèche). Sets DEX to 18 — lets the Bard dump DEX and pump CHA.

items.name: Diadem of Arcane Synergy
items.note: Ardent Jhe'rezath, Inquisitor's Chamber (Crèche). Inflicting a condition adds your casting mod to WEAPON-attack damage — dead on a pure caster (was mis-assigned to Toaster). Give it to Durc: Wrathful Smite / Hexblade's Curse proc it for +CHA weapon damage (Act 1–2 head, before Sarevok's Helmet).

items.name: Strange Conduit Ring
items.note: Crèche Y'llek. While Concentrating on a spell, your attacks deal +1d4 Psychic. Durc holds Wrathful Smite/Bless in his nova, so this adds psychic per swing — doubled by the Resonance Stone and again on a crit.

items.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies
items.note: Inquisitor's Chamber. Thunder/Lightning/Radiant applies Reverberation — Toaster's damage-glove pick (Spellmight Gloves are useless on his save-based AoE). At 5 Reverberation stacks the target must save or be knocked Prone — soft-CC that also sets up the melee.

items.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
items.note: Lady Esther. Auto-stabilise + always heal max — strong survivability amulet.

items.name: A'jak'nir Jeera — githyanki vendor stock
items.note: The Crèche quartermaster sells githyanki martial weapons, medium armour, whetstones, and the Gloves of Dexterity / Knife of the Undermountain King (core picks) — clear her stock (buy or steal) before leaving the Crèche, which locks.

items.name: Rosymorn / Crèche side-loot
items.note: The monastery and Crèche hold misc boots, potions, githyanki gear, and the Dawnmaster's Crest puzzle path to the Blood of Lathander — don't leave it under-looted. (Note: 'Everlasting Vigour' +2 STR is Araj's Act 2 potion, not a Rosymorn item.)

events.name: Blood of Lathander (legendary mace)
events.note: Rosymorn puzzle (Dawnmaster's Crest). +3 mace with Sunbeam + a party self-revive-at-0-HP aura — don't miss.

events.name: Zaith'isk → 'Awakened' permanent buff
events.note: Crèche infirmary machine: pass 3 saves (DC 12/15/18) for permanent Awakened (Illithid powers as bonus actions); failing = permanent −2 stat.

items.name: Moonlantern
items.note: Required to survive the region (shadow-curse protection). From Kar'niss after the Harper ambush, or Isobel/Balthazar.

items.name: Shadow of Menzoberranzan
items.note: Head slot, dropped by Kar'niss (the drider carrying the Moonlantern). Cast Invisibility 1/short rest while in shadow/darkness — excellent for any stealth or scout character (a strong alternative escape/ambush tool alongside Batman's kit).

events.name: Free the pixie (Dolly Dolly Dolly)
events.note: Freeing the pixie in the Moonlantern grants the party permanent Pixie's Blessing (curse immunity without holding the lantern). Missable.

items.name: Shadow Blade Ring
items.note: Arabella's reward for 'Find Arabella's Parents' (delivered at camp). Bonus-action Shadow Blade, short-rest recharge, no concentration — Durc's backup blade (Batman self-casts his own).

items.name: Coruscation Ring
items.note: Trapped chest in a hidden cellar room. Spell damage while illuminated inflicts Radiating Orb — a Radiating-Orb combo piece.

items.name: Covert Cowl
items.note: Cellar, on a Meenlock. While Obscured, crit threshold −1 — superb for BOTH Batman (attacks from stealth) and Durc (obscured crit-smite).

items.name: Potent Robe
items.note: Alfira hands it over at Last Light in ACT 2 — ONLY if she survived Act 1 (as the Dark Urge, Durc must knock her out before camp, not kill her). Adds CHA mod to cantrip damage.

events.name: Protect Isobel — DON'T let the inn fall
events.note: Stop the assassin Marcus from taking Isobel; if she dies the moonshield drops and the inn (vendors + quests) is lost. Missable.

events.name: Dammon (Karlach)
events.note: Second-stage infernal-engine upgrade + hellish gear.

items.name: Risky Ring
items.note: Sold by Araj Oblodra. Advantage on all attack rolls (disadvantage on saves) — Durc's always-advantage crit enabler (re-sold in Act 3 if missed).

items.name: Spineshudder Amulet
items.note: In a Mimic in Isobel's bedroom (upper floor, Moonrise). Applies Reverberation on your ranged SPELL-ATTACK hits only (not weapon hits or save spells) — good for a spell-attack caster, weak for Toaster's save-based nukes.

items.name: Moonrise Towers vendor & prison loot
items.note: Quartermaster Talli and the Moonrise traders sell heavy armour, martial weapons, and scrolls; the prison/temple levels hide gear and story items. Clear it before the assault — Moonrise is a point of no return.

events.name: Araj Oblodra — permanent +2 STR
events.note: If Astarion bites her on request, she gives a Potion of Everlasting Vigour = PERMANENT +2 Strength (any PC can drink). Astarion disapproves.

items.name: Killer's Sweetheart
items.note: Self-Same Trial (kill your shadow clone). After you KILL, your next attack is a GUARANTEED crit (refreshes on long rest) — a free crit-smite for Durc. ⚠ As an Oathbreaker, do NOT kill the clone with Control Undead (it instakills the copy but the ring won't drop) — land a normal killing blow.

items.name: Callous Glow Ring
items.note: Vault behind the DC30 door near Balthazar. +2 Radiant vs illuminated creatures — illumination combo piece.

items.name: Hellfire Hand Crossbow
items.note: Dropped by Yurgir (the orthon). Best hand crossbow in the game — Batman's ranged sidearm / off-hand.

items.name: Dark Justiciar Half-Plate & Spear of Night
items.note: Silent Library hidden chamber (tied to Shadowheart's arc) — solid heavy-armour + spear.

items.name: Full Dark Justiciar set (Mask / Gauntlets / Helmet)
items.note: Justiciar pieces span Grymforge (Act 1: Mask/Mail) and the Gauntlet (Half-Plate/Helmet/Gauntlets). The Dark Justiciar HELMET grants Covert Critical (crit threshold −1 while Obscured) — a SECOND obscured-crit head, so Durc and Batman can each run one (Covert Cowl + this) to crit on 19–20 in Darkness.

items.name: Umbral Gems (progression) + trial loot
items.note: Each trial hands an Umbral Gem (needed to reach the Nightsong) plus incidental gear — don't skip a trial thinking it's optional loot.

tadpole.title: Tadpole / Illithid Powers plan
tadpole.sub: Who eats which parasites, in what order — and who becomes the party's one partial-illithid.
tadpole.intro: Every Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen (a "tadpole") unlocks one Illithid power for one character, so they're a limited resource you assign deliberately — don't sprinkle them evenly. This party is a psychic-damage engine (the Resonance Stone makes a target Vulnerable to psychic), so the psychic powers — Concentrated Blast, Psionic Overload, Mind Blast, Cull the Weak — land for DOUBLE. Two rules drive the whole plan: illithid save DCs key off your latest-added class's casting stat (and stack Arcane Acuity), and only ONE character can ever become a partial-illithid for the elite tier.

mechanics.v: Act 1: after the Goblin Camp bridge cutscene, the Dream Guardian visits at the next long rest and starts Embrace Your Potential. From then, any parasite you pick up is fed straight into the Illithid Powers tree instead of sitting in your inventory.
Each parasite unlocks exactly one power for one character. Feed them to the carriers below in the priority order shown — an evenly-spread tree is a wasted one.

mechanics.k: Save DC = latest class's casting stat + Arcane Acuity
mechanics.v: Save-based illithid powers (Black Hole, Mind Blast, Stage Fright…) use the spellcasting modifier of the LAST class you added, and every spell-save-DC bonus (Arcane Acuity, Arcane Enchantment) applies on top. That's why the Commander — CHA 20 plus his Acuity stack — is the best save-power carrier, and why Gale (WIS after the Tempest dip) and Batman (INT) are not.

The single Astral-Touched Tadpole (from the Emperor at the very start of Act 3) turns exactly one character into a partial-illithid — the only way to reach the ELITE ring (Black Hole, Mind Blast, Freecast, Mind Sanctuary, Illithid Expertise…). It's offered to the Dark Urge first but can be handed to a companion with a Persuasion check. Everyone else is capped at the inner + middle rings.

Becoming partial-illithid instantly grants Concentrated Blast, Favourable Beginnings, Force Tunnel, Psionic Overload, Transfuse Health and Fly — and refunds any tadpoles already spent on those five inner powers, so early spends on them are effectively free.
Keep the Resonance Stone on the target and every psychic illithid power hits double: Concentrated Blast (3d6 → 6d6), Psionic Overload's +1d4/hit, Mind Blast, and Cull the Weak's AoE.

Partial ceremorphosis is a permanent cosmetic change (dark eyes, black veins; reverts only in the epilogue) and draws a few companion disapproval lines. No mechanical downside — fine for this min-max party.

carrier.why: Give the Astral-Touched Tadpole to the Commander. His Arcane Acuity engine (Slashing-Flourish hits → +spell save DC) stacks onto illithid save DCs, and his last class is Bard (CHA 20) — so Black Hole and Mind Blast land at the party's highest possible DC. Black Hole pulls a whole pack into one cluster (INT save at that sky-high DC) → the rest of the party AoEs the ball: Gale's Wet-doubled Lightning Bolt, Durc's cleave, the Commander's own bonus-action Command/Hold via the Band of the Mystic Scoundrel.
carrier.alt: Thematic alternative: let Durc (the Dark Urge) take it — he's auto-offered it and also has CHA 20, so his Mind Blast / Black Hole are still strong. But Durc's #1 power, Luck of the Far Realms, is middle-ring and needs no transformation, so he loses almost nothing by NOT being the carrier. Recommendation stands: the Commander eats it, Durc stays free.

order.power: Favourable Beginnings → Luck of the Far Realms
order.why: Two tadpoles for the single biggest early spike: once per long rest, turn a hit into a crit → doubled Divine Smite + Savage Attacker rerolls + a GWM bonus swing. Save it for the opening smite.

order.power: Favourable Beginnings → Luck of the Far Realms
order.why: Same combo for the Trickster: guarantee a crit on the opening Sneak Attack → doubled sneak dice. Favourable Beginnings also gives +proficiency to that first shot.
+proficiency to his first ranged attack each fight helps land the opening Slashing Flourish that starts the Acuity ramp. Refunded at his Act-3 transformation, so it costs nothing net.
+1d4 psychic per hit, DOUBLED by the Resonance Stone, across every attack of a multi-attacker. The self 1d4/turn is trivial behind Aura of Protection or a big HP pool.
Cull the Weak turns any low-HP enemy into a free kill plus a psychic AoE (doubled by Resonance) — great on the frontline where enemies cluster around him.

order.power: Luck of the Far Realms; Transfuse Health → Shield of Thralls
order.why: Luck sets up Illithid Expertise post-transformation; Transfuse Health → Shield of Thralls is the prerequisite chain for Freecast. Both inner picks are refunded at transformation — bank the tadpoles for the Act-3 elite spend.

order.power: Commune with the Astral-Touched Tadpole → partial-illithid
order.why: Persuade the party to route the Emperor's tadpole to the Commander. Auto-unlocks the five inner powers + Fly and refunds the tadpoles already spent on them, opening the elite ring.
THE payoff. Force Tunnel is already free from the transformation → one tadpole to Displace, one to Black Hole. Pull the pack into a cluster at his Acuity-boosted INT-save DC.
No prerequisite. A 4d8 + CHA psychic cone that Stuns on a failed INT save at his huge DC — an opening-turn AoE lockdown, and psychic so the Resonance Stone doubles it.

Illithid Expertise (via Luck) grants Expertise in Persuasion / Deception / Intimidation — piled onto the party face. Freecast (via Shield of Thralls) makes his next spell free: a no-slot 6th-level Command (6 targets) or Hold Monster.
Spend leftover parasites on Cull the Weak for the finishers and any missing inner-ring psychic powers. Gale generally donates his tadpoles here — see his row.

characters.name: SimonSays
characters.dc: CHA 20 + Arcane Acuity — the party's best illithid save DC by far.
characters.note: The elite-tier carrier. Eats the Astral-Touched Tadpole and turns the outer ring into reliable AoE control. Early inner-ring picks are refunded at the transformation, so nothing is wasted.

powers.why: +prof to the first ranged attack each fight; helps start the Acuity ramp. Free again (refunded) at transformation.
Prerequisite for Illithid Expertise; also a crit on demand for a big Slashing-Flourish burst.
10 temp HP on an ally, and the prerequisite for Freecast.
Pull a whole pack into one cluster + Slow, INT save at his Acuity-boosted DC. The party's premier AoE set-up.
4d8 + CHA psychic cone, Stun on a failed INT save; doubled by the Resonance Stone.
Next spell costs no slot — a free 6th-level Command (6 targets) or Hold Monster.
Expertise in Persuasion / Deception / Intimidation — stacks onto the party face.

characters.name: Durc
characters.dc: CHA 20 (Paladin is the last class added) — strong, but he isn't the partial-illithid, so no elite ring.
characters.note: Wants exactly two things from the tree, both inner/middle ring — no transformation needed.

powers.why: +prof to the first attack against each enemy — better odds to land the opening crit-smite.
TOP pick. Once per long rest, turn a hit into a crit → doubled Divine Smite, Savage Attacker rerolls, and a GWM bonus swing. Save it for the nova.
+1d4 psychic per hit across all three attacks, DOUBLED by the Resonance Stone. Self-damage is trivial behind Aura of Protection.
Low-HP enemies die outright plus a psychic AoE (doubled) — cleans up the pack after the nova.

characters.name: Batman
characters.dc: INT (Arcane Trickster is the last class) — weak save DCs, so stick to no-save powers.
characters.note: DEX sniper / duelist. Save-based illithid powers are wasted on his low INT DC; take the passive and reaction picks.

powers.why: +prof to his first attack on each target — a better opening Sneak Attack / crit-fish.
Turn the opening Sneak Attack hit into a guaranteed crit → doubled sneak dice. His biggest single-shot burst.
+1d4 psychic per hit across his attacks, doubled by the Resonance Stone.
His job is picking off low-HP targets — the free-kill + psychic AoE fits perfectly.

characters.name: Toaster
characters.dc: CHA while pure Sorcerer, but WIS (weak) after the Act-3 Tempest dip — and no elite ring.
characters.note: The odd one out: he makes no weapon attacks (so Psionic Overload and Favourable Beginnings are near-dead), and Concentrated Blast would drop his Haste concentration. His one high-value pick (Freecast) is elite-only and he isn't the carrier. Verdict: take almost nothing and donate his parasites to the Commander, Durc and Batman.

powers.why: Only real use is +prof to a first ability CHECK (skills) — marginal in combat.
Back-line reaction: an enemy casts → 1d4 per spell level of psychic (doubled by Resonance) to the caster. No DC needed — the only pick worth a spare tadpole on Gale.
Every other parasite is better spent on the three carriers above.
